brief.title: Route candidate tasks across four compute and reasoning budget regimes
brief.plain_summary: Score task dependency depth, branching factor, constraint count and Shannon ambiguity entropy to select zero_step_direct, fast_sketch, compressed_state_checkpoint or full_deliberative_verify under token and latency caps.
brief.outcome: Budget-clamped reasoning regime assignment and token allocation schedule.
